_comment: Keyword refinements for the per-comment 'Areas for improvement' column: first matching rule for the comment's area replaces the playbook's generic improvement text. [area, regex (case-insensitive), improvement text]. Ported from the prototype lookups.py.
rules: Stabilise biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) after updates and device changes; always offer a quick fallback to PIN/password.
Review session time-outs and forced log-outs; keep users signed in securely (e.g. biometric re-auth) rather than repeated full log-ins.
Fix NetCode/SMS/OTP delivery delays and failures; add in-app push approval and alternate delivery options.
Provide fast self-service reset/unlock (in-app identity check) so locked-out customers are not forced to call or visit a branch.
Strengthen release testing and staged roll-outs; update regressions (new versions breaking login, loading or features) are the main driver of complaints here.
Improve app start-up and screen-load speed; set and monitor performance targets for key journeys.
Reduce battery drain/overheating (background activity, polling) on the app.
Review blanket crypto/exchange payment restrictions; replace with risk-based controls and clear explanations plus a way to request a limit increase.
Speed up scam/fraud investigations and reimbursement decisions, give victims a named contact and clear timelines.
Cut false-positive account/card blocks, tell customers exactly why and how long, and enable instant self-service verification to release holds.
Add dark mode and basic personalisation options requested by customers.
Restore transaction screenshot/share and add shareable receipts (PDF/image) for proof of payment.
Add configurable real-time notifications (money in, card use, due dates).
Expand budgeting, spending insights and savings goals within the app.
Consult customers before big redesigns/updates; keep familiar navigation and provide an opt-out or transition period.
Reduce call wait times: offer call-back, extended hours and prominent in-app messaging.
Make chat/virtual assistants resolve real issues and provide a one-tap handover to a human.
Streamline complaints handling: clear ownership, timeframes and escalation without customers having to repeat themselves.
Coach frontline staff on empathy and ownership; track repeat contacts and first-contact resolution.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay Anyone / NPP)
Make PayID set-up/management simpler (add, change, delete) and surface clear payee-name confirmation.
Payments & transfers (PayID / BPAY / Pay Anyone / NPP)
Improve scheduled/recurring payment set-up and visibility, with reminders before debits.
Allow screenshots/sharing of transaction details or provide an in-app download-as-PDF/image option.
Improve Apple/Google Pay provisioning and tap-to-pay reliability; clearer error handling when a wallet card fails.
Give clear reasons for card declines and an instant way to resolve them (in-app unblock, retry).
